newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms UK green rate to revalue on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms UK green rate to revalue on Thursday.

text.p: The British green rate will on Thursday revalue to 0.720829 per Ecu from 0.742320 per Ecu, the European Commission confirmed.
Other green rates in the European Union's agrimonetary grid remain unchanged.

Earlier, U.K. Home Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) forecast the revaluation after green sterling averaged a positive monetary gap - the difference between green and market rates - of 5.629 percentage points during the fifth and final confirmation period between May 26 and June 4.
A revaluation of the green rate cuts the value of the amounts paid by Brussels to British farmers.

Green rates are used by the European Union to convert Ecus into the currencies of its member states for payments under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). -Peter Blackburn Brussels Bureau +322 287 6830
